db:select.db:sql: select (select count(*) from max.customers) as customers, (select count(*) from max.trades) as trades, (select count(*) from max.announcements) as announcements
select to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as d from (select distinct trade_date as d from max.prices) x order by d
select customer_id, code, side, qty, price, to_char(trade_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as trade_date from max.trades order by trade_date, trade_id
select customer_id, code, relation from max.insider_registry
select announcement_id, code, to_char(published_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as published_at, kind, title, price_move_pct from max.announcements order by published_at
select customer_id, code, announcement_id, alert_id from max.alerts

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import alerts from max::score output application/java var found = alerts(vars.days map $.d, vars.trades, vars.registry, vars.anns) var known = vars.existing map ($.customer_id ++ '/' ++ $.code ++ '/' ++ $.announcement_id) var fresh = found filter (not (known contains ($.customer_id ++ '/' ++ $.code ++ '/' ++ $.announcement_id))) var nextNo = (max(vars.existing map (($.alert_id as String)[3 to -1] as Number)) default 0) + 1 var lastDay = vars.days[-1].d --- fresh map ((a, i) -> a ++ { alert_id: 'SV-' ++ ((nextNo + i) as String {format: '0000'}), kind: 'インサイダー取引の疑い', raised_on: lastDay, reasons_json: write(a.reasons, 'application/json', {indent: false})})

db:bulk-insert.db:sql: insert into max.alerts (alert_id, kind, customer_id, code, announcement_id, score, reasons, raised_on) values (:alert_id, :kind, :customer_id, :code, :announcement_id, :score, cast(:reasons as jsonb), cast(:raised_on as date))

db:insert.db:sql: insert into max.audit_log (actor, action, target, detail) values ('system:surveillance', 'raise-alerts', :target, cast(:detail as jsonb))
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{target: (vars.raised map $.alert_id) joinBy ',', detail: write({count: sizeOf(vars.raised)}, 'application/json', {indent: false})}]

db:select.db:sql: select a.alert_id, a.kind, a.score, a.status, to_char(a.raised_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as raised_on, a.customer_id, c.name as customer_name, a.code, i.name as instrument_name, a.announcement_id from max.alerts a join max.customers c using (customer_id) join max.instruments i using (code) where (:status = '' or a.status = :status) order by a.score desc, a.alert_id

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- payload map { alertId: $.alert_id, kind: $.kind, score: $.score, status: $.status, raisedOn: $.raised_on, customerId: $.customer_id, customerName: $.customer_name, code: $.code, instrumentName: $.instrument_name, announcementId: $.announcement_id}]

db:select.db:sql: select a.alert_id, a.kind, a.score, a.status, cast(a.reasons as text) as reasons, to_char(a.raised_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as raised_on, a.customer_id, a.code, a.announcement_id from max.alerts a where a.alert_id = :id

select customer_id, name, name_kana, to_char(birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as birth_date, occupation, employer, annual_income, experience_years, risk_tolerance, to_char(opened_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as opened_on from max.customers where customer_id = :id
select code, name, sector, market from max.instruments where code = :code
select announcement_id, code, to_char(published_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as published_at, kind, title, price_move_pct from max.announcements where announcement_id = :id
select trade_id, side, qty, price, to_char(trade_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as trade_date, channel from max.trades where customer_id = :cid and code = :code order by trade_date, trade_id
select r.code, i.name as instrument_name, r.relation from max.insider_registry r join max.instruments i using (code) where r.customer_id = :cid order by r.code

select alert_id, status from max.alerts where alert_id = :id
